heading.title: Licensing of Drivers of Motor Vehicles

article.title: Responsibility of owners of motor vehicles for contravention of sections 3 and 4.
article.content:
5Responsibility of owners of motor vehicles for contravention of sections 3 and 4.

Section 5  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 14 of the Act
No owner or person in charge of a motor vehicle shall cause or permit any person who does not satisfy the provisions of section 3 or section 4 to drive the vehicle.
